snippet.title: Need for Seat | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the prototype free now on itch.io:
https://dead-leg-production.itch.io/need-for-seat
Follow us on Instagram
https://www.instagram.com/deadleg.prod/

Have you ever sat in an office chair, started pushing yourself around, and thought, “You know what? This would actually make a fun race”?
Yeah… us too. But the difference is, we actually made the game. 😂

This office chair racing game was born from a random idea during a late-night crunch, when our brains were fried from chasing bugs. One thing led to another, and now we have a prototype where you can drift in a chair, race through office hallways, and even use power-ups.

Disclaimer!
This game is a prototype still in development. Some (or many) features may be missing or contain bugs.

Follow Us
Follow us for the latest updates on this game through:
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/deadleg.prod/
- YouTube: youtube.com/@DeadlegProduction

Support Us!
Support us by sharing this prototype and making a donation. All funds will go directly toward the development of this game.

Donation : https://dead-leg-production.itch.io/need-for-seat


================================


Pernah nggak sih kamu duduk di kursi kantor, terus dorong-dorong sendiri sambil mikir, “Kayaknya seru juga ya kalau ini bisa jadi balapan”?
Nah… kami juga. Tapi bedanya, kami beneran bikin gamenya. 😂

Balapan kursi kantor ini lahir dari ide iseng waktu lembur, pas otak udah mumet sama bug. Satu hal mengarah ke yang lain, dan sekarang kami punya prototype di mana kamu bisa nge-drift pakai kursi, salip-salipan di lorong kantor, bahkan pake power-up.

Disclaimer!
Game ini merupakan prototipe yang masih berada di tahap pengembangan. Beberapa atau banyak fitur mungkin belum ada atau memiliki banyak bug.

Dukung Kami!
Dukung kami dengan membagikan prototipe ini dan memberikan donasi. Dana akan digunakan sepenuhnya untuk pengembangan game ini. 

Donasi: https://saweria.co/deadleg


================================
